mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/password-hashing.md <<'EOF'
# Password Hashing Policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use Argon2id as the password hashing algorithm for the authentication layer. Argon2id was chosen for its memory-hardness and its resistance to GPU-based and side-channel attacks, which gives password storage a stronger security posture against modern distributed brute-force attempts.
EOF
cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md
